title: DialogueNode
description: A single line of dialogue and its possible player responses. Not a standalone content file — dialogue nodes live inline in dialogueTree.nodes[].

id.description: Unique within the owning dialogue tree. Referenced by rootNodeId and other nodes' responses[].targetNodeId.

responses.description: Player-selectable responses to this line. A response without targetNodeId ends the dialogue.

targetNodeId.description: References another node's id within the same dialogue tree. Omit to end the dialogue.

script.description: Optional script run when the player selects this response.

condition.description: Optional gate: this response is only offered to the player when the condition holds against current GameState.

effects.description: Optional GameState mutation applied when the player selects this response.
